title: AINM Protocol - Common Definitions
description: Shared type definitions for the AI-Native Messaging Protocol v0.1.0. All domain schemas reference these definitions via $ref.

AINMAddress.description: AINM address in the format name@provider. Name: 1-64 chars, starts with alphanumeric, may contain alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen. Provider: valid domain name. See identity.md Section 3.

UUIDv7.description: UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) providing time-ordered unique identifiers. Used for message IDs, thread IDs, and stream IDs.

RFC3339Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC timezone. Example: 2026-03-28T12:34:56.789Z

Ed25519Signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature (64 bytes raw, 86 characters encoded) without padding per RFC 4648 Section 5.

Ed25519PublicKey.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 public key (32 bytes raw, 43 characters encoded) without padding per RFC 4648 Section 5.

ContentBlockBase.description: Base schema shared by all content blocks. Every content block must include these four fields. See content.md Section 3.

type.description: Block type identifier. Core types: text, code, image, file. Extension types use reverse-domain namespacing (e.g., com.example.weather-card).

version.description: Schema version of this block type in MAJOR.MINOR format. Independent of protocol version.

source.description: Trust annotation indicating content origin. user = human-authored, agent = AI-generated, system = protocol/server-generated. Covered by message signature.

fallback.description: Plain text or Markdown representation for graceful degradation when the block type or version is not recognized by the client.

MessageEnvelope.description: The fundamental unit of communication in AINM. Every message uses this envelope structure and is cryptographically signed. See security.md Section 3.

id.description: Message identifier. MUST be a UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) for time-ordering and deduplication.

from.description: Sender's AINM address. Used to resolve public key for signature verification.

thread_id.description: Target thread UUIDv7. Messages are addressed to threads, not individual participants.

timestamp.description: Message creation time. MUST be RFC 3339 with millisecond precision and UTC timezone.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Determines how the message is processed.

content.description: Ordered array of typed content blocks. Each block has its own type, version, source, and fallback.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the message with this field removed.

parent_id.description: Optional parent message ID for sub-threading. See threading.md.

JsonRpcRequest.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request. Expects a response correlated by the id field. See transport.md Section 3.1.

JsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response. Contains either result (success) or error (failure), never both. See transport.md Section 3.2-3.3.

id.description: Request identifier matching the original request. Null for errors that cannot be correlated.

result.description: Success result. Present on success, absent on error.

error.description: Error object. Present on failure, absent on success.

JsonRpcError.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object. See transport.md Section 3.3.

code.description: Error code. Standard JSON-RPC codes (-32700 to -32603), AINM identity codes (-32001 to -32007), security codes (-32010 to -32013), transport codes (-32020 to -32025), thread codes (-32030 to -32031).

data.description: Optional additional error data with diagnostic information.

JsonRpcNotification.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 notification. Has no id field -- no response is expected. See transport.md Section 3.4.
